events.title: 에버턴 defeat 코번트리 시티 1–0 in the FA Charity Shield at Wembley Stadium , with Wayne Clarke scoring the only goal of the game.
The Today newspaper cancels its sponsorship of the Football League after just one year, and less than two weeks before the new season is due to begin.
Britain's first million-pound player, Trevor Francis , returns to Britain when Graeme Souness signs him for 레인저스 in a £70,000 deal from 아탈란타 of Italy .
포츠머스 midfielder Mick Kennedy is fined £5,000 for claiming in a national newspaper that he was "the hardest man in football and proud of my reputation".
The Football League begins its centenary celebrations by hosting a match against a Rest of the World XI at Wembley. 디에고 마라도나 and 게리 리네커 are in the side beaten by a Football League XI.
Former 리즈 유나이티드 and England manager Don Revie , 60, announces that he is suffering from motor neurone disease , which was diagnosed in May this year.

Barclays Bank become the Football League's new sponsors in a three-year deal worth in the region of £5million, while 포츠머스 prepare for their first top division campaign since the 1950s by paying 리즈 유나이티드 £285,000 for striker Ian Baird .

The Football League season begins. In the First Division, 퀸스 파크 레인저스 record the biggest win of the day by beating 웨스트햄 유나이티드 3–0. Champions 에버턴 beat 노리치 시티 1–0, and 리버풀 win 2–1 away to 아스널. Scarborough , new members after their promotion to the Fourth Division from the GM Vauxhall Conference , hold fallen giants 울버햄프턴 원더러스 to a 2–2 draw, but crowd trouble results in 56 arrests.

Newly promoted First Division side 더비 카운티 pay a club record £760,000 for 사우샘프턴 defender Mark Wright. UEFA announce that if the ban on English clubs in Europe is lifted in time for the 1988–89 UEFA Cup , there will only be two slots available for clubs in England due to their UEFA coefficient falling.
Brian McClair scores his first goal for 맨체스터 유나이티드 in their 2–0 home league win over 왓퍼드. In the first top flight South Coast derby , newly promoted 포츠머스 draw 2–2 with 사우샘프턴 at Fratton Park .
Striker Terry Gibson ends his unsuccessful 18-month spell at 맨체스터 유나이티드 and joins 윔블던 for £200,000.
루턴 타운 lift their ban on away fans and are allowed to compete in the League Cup , from which they were banned last season.

맨체스터 유나이티드 finish August as First Division leaders, two points ahead of 퀸스 파크 레인저스 and 노팅엄 포리스트. At the bottom of the table, 찰턴 애슬레틱 , 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 루턴 타운 remain without a League win so far this season. In the Second Division, 플리머스 아가일 and 반즐리 lead the way on goal difference, but fancied 애스턴 빌라 are fourth from bottom.
